subject: Re: Admin activity evidence — bulk delivery and scoped retention plan
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@medicorex.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@medicorex.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity extract request and retention clarification

Vanessa —

Thanks for taking this with us. As part of our SIG assessment we need a reproducible export of admin activity for the tenant 'medicorex-prod' covering July 1–13, 2025. Our security team wants:

- a CSV extract with event-level rows (timestamp, user_email, action, target_resource, ip, grpc_request_id)
- confirmation of which admin actions are recorded (role changes, API key usage, delegated access grants, console logins, service account activity)
- the retention policy currently applied to admin activity (hot store vs. archival TTL) and any available point-in-time snapshots

Could you also confirm whether we can request an on-demand bulk export (SFTP/HTTPS presigned) and the expected lead time? We may request PII redaction for a subset of events.

Appreciate your help — we have a vendor review on Wednesday.

—Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Security Operations, MedicoRex
alex.moreno@medicorex.com
+1 415 555 0192

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@medicorex.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity extract request and retention clarification

Alex —

Thanks — I took a quick look and looped in Kim (compliance/ops) and Rishi (runtime). High level answers first, details below and we can schedule a short call if you prefer.

1) Export shape: we can provide a CSV with the fields you listed plus an internal event_id and region tag. We include ISO8601 timestamps in UTC and canonical user identifiers (email or service account id).

2) What’s logged: role grants/revokes, identity provider linked auth events (SSO sign-ins + SAML assertion results), API key creations and use, admin console session starts/stops, impersonation events, RBAC policy changes, and queued background jobs triggered by admin actions. We also capture KV-cache invalidation events tied to model rollouts.

3) Retention: admin activity is stored in a 90-day hot store by default for hosted customers, with 2-year cold archive available on request for enterprise-paid retention. Point-in-time snapshots can be generated (attested manifest + HMAC) and signed; these are produced as a single snapshot bundle.

4) On-demand bulk export: yes — we support HTTPS presigned tarball downloads or SFTP push. Typical turnaround for a 90-day export is 48–72 hours for standard-sized tenants; expedited (24h) is available under our enterprise SLA. Exports include a manifest and sha256 checksums.

5) PII redaction: we support field-level redaction rules (email hashing, ip truncation) and can apply a sampling-based redaction for fields flagged in SIG/CAIQ reviews.

I'll attach an excerpt for the requested window and a one-page export approach doc. Kim/Rishi — can you confirm the expedited SLA and whether we need to open a secure support ticket to kick off the signed snapshot?

Thanks,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachments: admin_activity_excerpt_2025-07-01_2025-07-13.csv; export_instructions_approach.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@medicorex.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity extract request and retention clarification

Alex / Vanessa —

Confirming the expedited path: we can action a signed snapshot for your tenant within 24 hours once a secure ticket is opened and the export parameters are locked (time window, redaction rules, delivery method). Notes:

- Exports produced for legal/compliance will include an attested manifest (timestamped, HMAC) and a checksum file.
- For redaction: we can either hash emails using a salted HMAC (you provide the salt via secure channel) or mask the local part. IP addresses can be truncated to /24.
- If you request the 2-year archive pull (cold store), add 2–3 business days to the timeline for tape retrievals in the archive tier.

Action items I need from MedicoRex to start:
1) confirm exact time window (if you need midnight-to-midnight, specify TZ)
2) choose redaction preference (hash with salt / mask / no-redaction)
3) delivery method (SFTP push to host you provide OR HTTPS presigned URL)

Once we have those, I will generate a secure support ticket and route to the export team.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@medicorex.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2025 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity extract request and retention clarification

Kim / Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear answers. Quick replies to your items:

1) Time window: 2025-07-01T00:00:00Z through 2025-07-13T23:59:59Z (UTC)
2) Redaction: please hash emails with HMAC-SHA256 using a salt we will provide via your secure intake form. We still need source IPs but are comfortable with /24 truncation.
3) Delivery: HTTPS presigned URL is preferred — we will download and verify checksums.

Please open the support ticket and mark as expedited. Also include the attested manifest in the tarball. If you can confirm ETA in hours once the ticket is created, that would be great — we need to show the export path to our auditors.

Alex
—
